summary: Thubten Jigme Norbu was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied under Thubten Lungtog Tenzin Trinley and Geshe Ngawang Nyima. He served as director at the Library of Tibetan Works and Archives (~1970–1972) and Professor at Indiana University (1965–1992).

Thubten Lungtog Tenzin Trinley studied under the 13th Dalai Lama (~1905–1933) and Trijang Rinpoche. As a teacher, his students included Tenzin Gyatso, Thubten Jigme Norbu, and Lobsang Phuntshok Lhalungpa.

Thubten Zopa Rinpoche worked in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and Tibetology, studying at Dungkar Monastery and under Lama Thubten Yeshe, Geshe Rabten, and Tenzin Gyatso, among others. He founded the FPMT, serving as its spiritual director in 1984.

Thupten Jinpa is a scholar of Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy who earned a Geshe Lharam at Ganden Monastery and a B.A. from Cambridge. He held posts at Girton College, Cambridge, Stanford University, and the Institute of Tibetan Classics.

Thupten Samphel was a Tibetologist who studied at St. Stephen's College (~1975–1978), the University of Delhi (~1975–1980), and Columbia University (~1980–1982). He held a post at the Tibet Policy Institute from 2012 to 2018.

Théodore Pavie was an Indologist and Sinologist who studied under Eugène Burnouf (~1838–1845). He served as Professor of Sanskrit at the Collège de France (1852–1857) and taught Hebrew lessons and lectures at the Catholic University of the West in 1862.

Thích Minh Châu was a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a PhD at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (~1957–1961). He served as a Chinese lecturer at Nava Nalanda Mahavihara (~1958–1961) and Vice Chancellor of Vạn Hạnh University (~1964–1975).

Thích Thiện Châu was a scholar in Buddhist studies. He pursued his education in France, studying at Paris-Sorbonne University (~1967–1971) and Sorbonne Nouvelle University (~1970–1977), where he completed his doctoral dissertation.

Tianshu Zhu specializes in Buddhist studies, history, and archaeology. Educated at Northwest University (MA) and Ohio State University (PhD under John C. Huntington), Zhu has held posts at Northwest University, Shaanxi History Museum, Korea University, and Ohio State University.

Tiberius Hemsterhuis was a scholar in linguistics, history, and archaeology who studied at Leiden University (~1702–1705). He subsequently held posts at the University of Amsterdam (1704–1717), the University of Franeker (~1717–1740), and Leiden University (1740–1765).

Tilak Kariyawasam is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He served as head of the Department of Pali and Buddhist Studies at the University of Kelaniya (attested 1993) and Dean of the Graduate School at International Buddhist College (attested 2014).

Tilmann Vetter was an Indologist, philosopher, and Buddhist studies scholar who earned his PhD at the University of Vienna studying under Erich Frauwallner and Erich Heintel. In 1974, he was appointed professor at Leiden University.

Timothy H. Barrett is a scholar in sinology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies who studied at the University of Cambridge and Yale University. He taught at Cambridge (attested 1981) and became a professor at SOAS University of London in 1986.

Timothy Lenz is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed graduate studies at the University of Washington under Richard Salomon and Collett Cox. He held posts at the University of Washington, where he was attested as professor in 2017.
Timothy Lubin is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who earned his PhD from Columbia University in 1994. He was attested as holding a post at Washington and Lee University in 2020.
Tina Rasmussen is a scholar in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She studied under traditional teacher Pa-Auk Sayadaw and completed an MA under the supervision of Christian K. Wedemeyer.

Tirumalai Krishnamacharya was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at The Queen's College, Oxford, and the University of Mysore, and with Ramamohana Brahmachari. He taught at Maharaja's Sanskrit College, Mysore (1931) and Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College (~1953–1958).

Tissa Rajapatirana is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at the Australian National University (1966–1974) under Jan Willem de Jong. He was attested in ANU's Department of South Asian and Buddhist Studies in 1988.
Tiziana Pontillo is a scholar of Indology and linguistics. She studied at the University of Cagliari in 2016 and held a post there in 2022.
Todd Gibson is a scholar in Tibetology and religious studies. He studied under György Kara and earned a PhD at Indiana University, attested in 1991.
